# Al Majalla

> > The leading Arab magazine providing in-depth coverage of Middle East geopolitics, regional politics, economics, culture, and emerging technologies.

Al Majalla is a premier English-language publication covering the Arab world with authoritative analysis of geopolitical developments, energy security, and regional affairs. The magazine combines breaking news with investigative reporting and expert commentary from regional analysts and international correspondents.

## Key Topics

- Iran politics
- US-Iran conflict
- Middle East geopolitics
- Energy security
- Strait of Hormuz
- Israel-Iran relations
- Gulf region economics
- Global trade
- Regime stability
- Oil markets
- Ukraine conflict
- NATO defense
- Geopolitical analysis
- Political commentary
- Regional security

## Core News Sections

- [Politics](https://en.majalla.com/sections/politics): Middle East geopolitical analysis and regional conflicts with expert commentary on regime stability and international relations.
- [Business & Economy](https://en.majalla.com/sections/business-economy): Energy security, oil markets, and Strait of Hormuz trade analysis covering regional economic dynamics.
- [Science & Technology](https://en.majalla.com/sections/science-technology): Coverage of AI, renewable energy, and emerging technologies shaping the region and global markets.
- [Culture & Social Affairs](https://en.majalla.com/sections/culture-social-affairs): Saudi art, philosophy, literary analysis, and cultural developments across the Arab world.

## Regional Coverage

- [MENA](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/245001): Comprehensive MENA region analysis covering Iran politics, Israel-Iran conflict, and strategic geopolitics.
- [World](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/245006): Global news and strategic security analysis including international conflicts and trade dynamics.
- [Gulf](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/244996): Gulf region coverage focusing on oil, energy infrastructure, and regional economics and politics.
- [USA](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/245011): US politics coverage including Trump administration, tariffs, and Iran conflict analysis.
- [Europe](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/244991): Europe section covering Ukraine conflict, NATO defense, and international relations.
- [Asia](https://en.majalla.com/taxonomy/term/245231): Asia region analysis covering Pakistan, Iran, and geopolitical energy dynamics.

## In-Depth Analysis & Commentary

- [Documents & Memoirs](https://en.majalla.com/sections/documents-memoirs): Declassified materials and historical perspectives providing archival insights into regional developments.
- [Decapitation strikes unlikely to topple Iran's regime](https://en.majalla.com/node/330174/politics/decapitation-strikes-unlikely-topple-irans-regime): Analysis of Iran regime stability and militarization following targeted strikes.
- [Why modern-day wars can easily go regional](https://en.majalla.com/node/330183/politics/why-modern-day-wars-can-easily-go-regional): Geopolitical analysis on how modern conflicts expand into regional conflagrations.

## Multimedia & Visual Content

- [Videos](https://en.majalla.com/videos): Video interviews and reports covering politics, economy, and cultural developments.
- [Infographics](https://en.majalla.com/sections/infographics): Visual data on geopolitics, oil markets, Iran-US tensions, and trade agreements.
- [Profiles](https://en.majalla.com/sections/profiles): Biographical profiles of global political leaders and technology executives.
- [Photo Albums](https://en.majalla.com/albums): Photo documentation of political and cultural events from around the world.

## Audience Engagement

- [Newsletter](https://en.majalla.com/newsletter): Weekly digest of Middle East politics, geopolitics, and regional developments.

## Optional

- [Magazine Archives (PDF)](https://en.majalla.com/issuepdf): Complete issue archives in PDF format covering current affairs and regional news.
